name: Bladesinging
summary: Elegant warrior-wizards who dance with a blade.

features.name: Training in War and Song
features.short: Light armor, one melee weapon, Performance.
features.summary: You gain proficiency with light armor, one one-handed melee weapon of your choice, and the Performance skill.

features.name: Bladesong
features.short: Bonus action: +INT AC, +10 speed, advantage on Acrobatics and concentration.
features.summary: As a bonus action, while not wearing medium/heavy armor or a shield, you start the Bladesong for 1 minute: add your INT modifier to AC, +10 ft. walking speed, advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and add INT to concentration saves. Uses: PB per long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.short: Attack twice; replace one attack with a cantrip.
features.summary: You can attack twice when you take the Attack action, and you can cast a cantrip in place of one of those attacks.

features.name: Song of Defense
features.short: Reaction in Bladesong: spend a slot to reduce damage.
features.summary: While your Bladesong is active, when you take damage you can use your reaction to expend a spell slot and reduce the damage by five times the slot's level.

features.name: Song of Victory
features.short: In Bladesong, add INT to melee weapon damage.
features.summary: While your Bladesong is active, you add your Intelligence modifier to the damage of your melee weapon attacks.
